verdict.rationale: Bun is a developer tool, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, endpoint, or serve mode. The llms.txt and docs.md probes are AI-readable documentation, an adjacent feature that does not let an agent connect via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
